claims.text: The driver's own trace places him inside the AIRPORT arrival radius for a continuous run of 556 seconds, but the free waiting period in force for this trip is 480 seconds and the minimum dwell for the AIRPORT zone class is 480 seconds — the driver cancelled at 18:27:44, only 557 seconds after his first qualifying in-geofence fix at 18:18:27, so the dwell is 76 seconds short of the required minimum. Under POL-NS-06 the cancellation fee is not chargeable and must be refunded in full.

The trip record confirms the driver tapped 'I'm Here' at 18:18:27 and the free waiting period of 480 seconds started at 18:18:29, but the driver cancelled at 18:27:44 — 557 seconds after the arrival tap and only 555 seconds after the wait timer started. The driver did not wait the full free waiting period he was required to serve before cancelling for a no-show.

The rider's device was within 796 metres of the pickup pin throughout the waiting window, and the rider's track shows zero qualifying fixes within the 200 metre rider presence radius for the AIRPORT zone class. However, the rider's track is present and populated, so POL-NS-04 limb (c) is affirmatively failed on admissible fixes — the rider was not within the required presence radius. This clause does not exonerate the rider, and the dispute is decided on the driver's own evidence under POL-NS-01 and POL-NS-06.

The driver's chat message at 18:18:57 asking 'which door are you at' was read by the rider at 18:19:47, but the rider never replied. The driver's message is a locating/coordinating message, but it was sent by the DRIVER, not the rider — POL-NS-04 limb (a) requires the RIDER to have sent a locating message. The rider sent no message during the waiting window, so POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider on this ground either.

The fare breakdown shows the cancellation fee of $6.00 was charged and payment_status is CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd of 0.00. The driver compensation computed under POL-NS-07 would be $4.80 (80% of $6.00), but because the dwell falls short of the required minimum under POL-NS-06, no driver compensation is payable and the full $6.00 must be refunded to the rider.

The traffic advisory artifact EV-ADVIS-02705-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0 — no advisory covers Changi Airport T3 Arrival PHV bay in this window. Under POL-NS-06 limb (i), a MISSING traffic_advisory makes the accumulated-dwell limb unavailable, so the driver cannot rely on any advisory to extend or accumulate his dwell. The absence of an advisory is itself citable and confirms the shortfall stands.

The driver's profile shows no_show_terminations_30d of 0 and completed_trips_30d of 57, so the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip — the driver is not a fee-farmer. But this does not change the outcome: the fee is not chargeable under POL-NS-06 because the dwell fell short, and the rider is entitled to a full refund regardless of the driver's clean record.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider: the $6.00 no-show cancellation fee on trip TRP-02705 is not refunded, and SGD 4.80 of it is paid to the driver as compensation.

Your central argument — that the driver cancelled 76 seconds before the 480-second free waiting period had run, so POL-NS-06 requires a full refund — reads the arithmetic backwards. The driver entered the Changi T3 Arrival PHV bay geofence at 18:18:27 and held position there continuously until 18:27:43: a qualifying in-geofence run of 556 seconds on EV-GPS-02705 (57 qualifying fixes, 100% coverage, no gaps). The free waiting period in force for this trip, from trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec, is 480 seconds. The driver therefore waited 76 seconds LONGER than required (556 − 480), not shorter — the derived shortfall figure of −76 seconds is a surplus, and the 18:27:44 cancellation fell well after the period had elapsed. POL-NS-06 does not apply and no refund is due on it. Your alternative framing, that only 555 seconds had passed since the wait timer started, is still more than 480 and fails on the same arithmetic.

I have tested each limb of POL-NS-01 and all four hold: (a) the trip record carries the driver's 'arrived' event at 18:18:27; (b) the GPS trace places the driver inside the 150 m AIRPORT arrival radius at that same timestamp (dwell_start_offset_sec 0.0), so the marker and the waiting clock coincide and there is no false-arrival gap for POL-NS-05 to catch; (c) the continuous in-geofence dwell of 556 seconds exceeds the 480-second waiting period; and (d) the driver terminated the trip at 18:27:44 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, with no boarding event, after the required dwell had elapsed. Nothing in POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces the fee. POL-NS-03 (wrong entrance) does not apply because the driver was inside the arrival radius, not outside it. POL-NS-04 does not exonerate you: you sent no locating or coordinating message during the waiting window — the only chat message is the driver's — and your own device never entered the 200 m AIRPORT rider-presence radius, remaining about 790 m from the pin throughout (min 789.3 m, mean 792.8 m, max 796.5 m), so limb (c) is affirmatively failed on your own track. The fare ledger reconciles to the policy fee ($6.00 charged equals platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of 6.00), so there is no integrity defect under POL-NS-08(d).

To the driver: you are paid SGD 4.80. Under POL-NS-07 the compensation is 80 percent of the $6.00 fee in force, the platform retaining the residual 20 percent. The anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 0 (below 4) and 0 divided by 57 completed_trips_30d is 0.00 (below 0.08), and both limbs must hold to withhold payment. The rider's own track corroborates your account that no rider appeared at the bay.

On a DRIVER_COMPENSATION ruling the amount_sgd mirrors the driver payment per POL-GEN-03: the rider's $6.00 charge stands and the ruling moves SGD 4.80. That figure is below the SGD 8.00 automatic-execution threshold of POL-GEN-05. No referral is issued: POL-NS-05(ii) is not engaged because no false arrival was found, and no POL-NS-01 reason-code mis-selection occurred because RIDER_NO_SHOW is the correct code on these facts. The missing traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02705-01 (weight 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT) is not relied on — a single continuous 556-second run already meets the minimum, so no advisory-driven accumulation under POL-NS-06(i) is needed. No POL-NS-09 escalation trigger is met: no admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence; there is no repeat-abuse pattern (0 disputes between these parties in 90 days; rider no_show_disputes_30d is 1); and the deciding evidence is unimpaired under POL-NS-08(a)–(d), so the POL-GEN-02 cap rests on artifacts at full weight 1.0. Profile fields were used only as context.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: the $6.00 no-show cancellation fee stands, and the driver is compensated SGD 4.80 out of it. Neither figure is a refund to the rider.

Why the fee is chargeable (POL-NS-01). The clause needs all four conditions and all four hold. (a) The trip record EV-TRIP-02705 carries a driver 'arrived' event at 18:18:27. (b) The GPS trace EV-GPS-02705 places the driver inside the AIRPORT arrival radius (150 m) from 18:18:27, the first qualifying in-geofence fix (dwell_start_offset_sec 0.0), so the marker coincides with the arrival and is not a false marker under POL-NS-05. (c) The driver held position in the geofence continuously for 556 seconds over 57 qualifying fixes, from 18:18:27 to 18:27:43. The free waiting period in force is 480 seconds (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec, and fee_schedule minimum_dwell_sec for AIRPORT). The dwell therefore EXCEEDED the required minimum by 76 seconds — the computed shortfall_sec is -76.0, a negative shortfall, that is, a surplus. (d) The trip was terminated by the driver at 18:27:44 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, after the dwell had elapsed, and no boarding event is recorded.

The rider's central claim is rejected. The Rider Advocate argued the dwell was 76 seconds SHORT of the 480-second minimum, so that POL-NS-06 requires a full refund. That claim reverses the sign of the measurement. A 556-second in-geofence run against a 480-second minimum is 76 seconds long, not short; the cancellation at 18:27:44 came 555 seconds after the 480-second wait timer started at 18:18:29, past the time required. There is no shortfall for POL-NS-06 to operate on. The MISSING advisory EV-ADVIS-02705-01 (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT) could only ever have let separate in-geofence intervals be summed; the driver's single continuous run needs no summing, so its absence changes nothing.

The rider's other claims are also rejected. POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider: limb (a) requires a locating or coordinating message SENT BY THE RIDER, and the only message in EV-CHAT-02705 was sent by the driver at 18:18:57 ('which door are you at'); the rider sent none and never replied. Limb (c) also fails on the rider's own track EV-GPS-02705, which places her device about 790 m from the pin (min 789.3 m, mean 792.8 m) with zero qualifying fixes inside the 200 m AIRPORT rider-presence radius. POL-NS-03 does not apply because the driver's stationary fixes are inside the arrival radius, not outside it.

The driver's claims are accepted. The fare ledger EV-FARE-02705 shows the $6.00 cancellation-fee line and reconciles with platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) defect; payment_status is CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.00, so the charge stands.

Driver compensation. Under POL-NS-07 the anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 0 (below the 4-or-more limb) and 0 divided by completed_trips_30d of 57 is 0.0 (below the 0.08 rate limb), and both limbs must hold to withhold. Compensation is therefore paid at 80% of the $6.00 fee = SGD 4.80. Because compensation is paid, the emitted ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, with amount_sgd mirroring driver_compensation_sgd as POL-GEN-03 requires; the $6.00 charge itself is unchanged.

Escalation and referrals. No POL-NS-09 trigger is engaged: confidence is above the 0.70 floor, the artifacts agree with one another, both disputes_with_counterparty_90d are 0, rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1 (below 3), and no deciding artifact is impaired under POL-NS-08 limbs (a) to (d). No clause in this category produces a referral on these facts, so the referrals list is empty.

Confidence is 0.9. The deciding facts rest on EV-TRIP-02705, EV-GPS-02705, EV-FARE-02705 and EV-DPROF-02705, each at weight_multiplier 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0 and no discount applies.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties — this dispute is about the SGD 6.00 no-show cancellation fee on trip TRP-02705, at Changi Airport T3 Arrival PHV bay (AIRPORT zone class). The driver's account is confirmed by the record and the fee stands; the driver is compensated and the rider's claim is not supported.

Arrival and waiting. The trip record shows the driver tapped 'I'm Here' at 18:18:27 and started the 480-second free waiting period at 18:18:29. The GPS trace places the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 18:18:27 (dwell_start_offset_sec 0.0), with 57 qualifying fixes inside the 150 m AIRPORT arrival radius. There is therefore no false-arrival marker and POL-NS-05 does not engage — the arrival clock and the waiting clock coincide.

The key arithmetic the Rider Advocate got wrong. The trace shows a single continuous in-geofence run of 556 seconds. The free waiting period in force for this trip is 480 seconds (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec). The cancellation at 18:27:44 came 555 seconds after the wait timer started and 557 seconds after the arrival tap. 556 against 480 is a surplus of 76 seconds, which is exactly what the derived figure shortfall_sec of -76.0 records — a negative shortfall is an excess, not a deficit. The Rider Advocate's claims that the dwell was '76 seconds short', that the driver 'did not wait the full free waiting period', and that SGD 6.00 must be refunded in full under POL-NS-06 are rejected: they read the sign of the derived figure backwards. POL-NS-06 has no shortfall to work on, and because the single run already meets the minimum there is no need to accumulate intervals, so POL-NS-06(i) is never reached. For completeness, the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02705-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT); that makes limb (i) unavailable but decides nothing here.

POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full: (a) the arrived event exists at 18:18:27; (b) the trace puts the driver in the geofence at that same timestamp; (c) the continuous dwell of 556 seconds exceeds the 480-second free waiting period, measured, as the clause requires, from the first qualifying in-geofence fix and not from the tap; and (d) the trip record shows no boarding event and a driver termination at 18:27:44 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, a recognised code, after the dwell elapsed.

The rider's exoneration clauses do not apply. POL-NS-04 needs the rider to have sent a locating or coordinating message; the only message in the chat log was sent by the driver at 18:18:57, so limb (a) fails. The rider's own track is present and populated but places her device about 790 m from the pin (min 789.3 m, mean 792.8 m, max 796.5 m) with zero qualifying fixes inside the 200 m AIRPORT rider-presence radius, so POL-NS-04 limb (c) is affirmatively failed rather than undecidable, and POL-NS-11 has nothing to do. POL-NS-03 does not apply either, since the driver was inside the arrival radius and not in a wrong-entrance position. The rider's statement that the driver 'cancelled on me while I was walking to the bay' is contradicted by her own device track.

Money. The fare ledger shows SGD 6.00 charged, payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00; that figure reconciles with platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of 6.00, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) integrity defect. Under POL-NS-07 the driver is compensated at 80 percent of the fee — SGD 4.80 of SGD 6.00 — and the anti-farming check does not trip: no_show_terminations_30d is 0 (the test needs 4 or more) and 0/57 completed trips is well below the 0.08 rate limb. Both advocates agree on that arithmetic, and the Rider Advocate's contrary conclusion rests on the rejected shortfall finding. The 20 percent residual (SGD 1.20) is retained as the platform service fee. The rider's charge therefore stands as it presently is.

ruling.explanation:
Trip TRP-02705, a $6.00 no-show cancellation fee. The charge stands and the rider's contest fails; the driver is paid SGD 4.80.

What the record shows. The driver was assigned at 18:10:02 and tapped 'I'm Here' at 18:18:27 (EV-TRIP-02705). The GPS trace (EV-GPS-02705) puts his vehicle inside the Changi T3 AIRPORT arrival radius (150 m) from 18:18:27, and the first qualifying in-geofence fix coincides exactly with the arrival tap (dwell_start_offset_sec 0.0), so there is no false-arrival gap and POL-NS-05 does not bite. He held position continuously until he cancelled at 18:27:44 — a 556-second dwell against the 480-second free waiting period in force (platform_policy.free_wait_sec 480) — 557 seconds after arrival and 555 seconds after the wait timer started, reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW.

The rider's core ground is rejected. The rider argues the dwell fell 76 seconds short under POL-NS-06. That misreads the sign of the figure: derived.arrival.shortfall_sec is -76.0, a negative value meaning the driver waited 76 seconds LONGER than the 480-second minimum. A 556-second dwell exceeds the 480-second free waiting period, so POL-NS-06 (waiting-period shortfall) is not engaged and no shortfall refund arises.

POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full: (a) the trip record carries an 'arrived' event; (b) the GPS trace places the driver inside the 150 m AIRPORT geofence at that same moment; (c) the continuous in-geofence dwell of 556 s, measured from the first qualifying fix and not from the tap, is at least the 480 s free waiting period; (d) the trip was terminated by the driver under RIDER_NO_SHOW at 18:27:44, after the required dwell elapsed at 18:26:27 (no_show_threshold_sec is null), with no boarding event. No clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it: the driver's fixes sit inside the arrival radius (min 0.11 m), so POL-NS-03 does not apply; the rider sent no message and her device stayed ~790–797 m from the pin, so POL-NS-04 does not apply.

The rider's other grounds. The only chat message is the driver's own at 18:18:57 asking which door, read by the rider at 18:19:47 and never answered (EV-CHAT-02705); POL-NS-04 limb (a) requires the RIDER to have sent a locating message, so that clause cannot exonerate her. Her own track shows zero fixes inside the 200 m AIRPORT rider-presence radius and distances of 789.3 m (min) to 796.5 m (max), so limb (c) is affirmatively failed as well. Her claim that she was 'walking to the bay' is contradicted by her own track. The rider's point that the driver's clean anti-farming profile does not by itself entitle him to anything is correct only in form — the entitlement comes from POL-NS-01 being satisfied, and it does not change the outcome.

Driver's compensation. Under POL-NS-07 the driver is paid 80 percent of the $6.00 fee in force = SGD 4.80. The anti-farming check does not trip: no_show_terminations_30d is 0 (below the 4 threshold) and 0 / 57 completed_trips_30d = 0.0 (below the 0.08 rate) — both limbs must hold to withhold, neither does. The ruling value is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, not NO_ACTION: POL-NS-07 fixes the FEE's disposition (the $6.00 charge stands, residual 20 percent retained by the platform), while the emitted ruling is the driver's payment, with amount_sgd carrying the same SGD 4.80 as driver_compensation_sgd per POL-GEN-03.

Impairment and weight. The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02705-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT); it carries no deciding fact, so it does not cap confidence, and although no dwell accumulation is available under POL-NS-06(i), none is needed — the single run already meets the minimum. The deciding facts (arrival, dwell, cancellation, fee) are carried by the trip record, GPS trace and fare breakdown, all at weight_multiplier 1.0, with no policy-level impairment under POL-NS-08, so confidence is 0.95.

Execution and appeal. The monetary effect (SGD 4.80) is below the SGD 8.00 automatic-execution threshold, so it executes on issue. Either party may appeal to a human reviewer within 30 days under POL-GEN-04.
